holders.name: STATE STREET BANK AND TRUST COMPANY 505001

notes: Evo Fund and its joint holders reported 334,732,550 share-equivalents (株券等, which can include rights as well as shares) as of 2026-05-08 in a large-shareholding change report. Metaplanet said it could not confirm the shares actually held, so that figure is not listed as a share holding.

The shareholder-register counts include Class B preferred shares, which do not vote. Several names are standing proxies for custody accounts, not confirmed beneficial owners, and they are not added to the large-shareholding figures.
EDINET is not queried directly. Figures are from Metaplanet's disclosures, which cite the large-shareholding reports. Register source: 半期報告書－第28期(2026/01/01－2026/12/31) (2026-08-13).

Estimated institutional (owner-type table, Dec 31, 2025): ~44.6%. The raw financial-institution plus foreign-corporation share is 69.3%. 44.6% excludes retail custody and nominee accounts (Charles Schwab FBO, National Financial Services, Interactive Brokers, and Morgan Stanley Smith Barney) and the CEO's MMXX Ventures. Those names are in the Dec 31, 2025 major-shareholder table of the same report.

Insiders: MMXX Ventures plus Simon Gerovich own about 9.5–10.9%. At Dec 31, 2025 the annual report shows MMXX at 42,474,750 shares (3.64% of shares outstanding excluding treasury; 3.72% of voting rights) and Simon Gerovich at 15,555,500 shares. A large-shareholding report as of Sep 9, 2025 reported MMXX at 5.62% of 株券等, which can include rights. The Oct 2, 2026 correction says Gerovich does not hold a majority of MMXX, so the two are added rather than treated as one controlled block. Sources: https://metaplanet.jp/disclosure-pdf/S100XTWY.pdf and https://metaplanet.jp/disclosure-pdf/S100Z5LW.pdf.
